d:
Immerse yourself in the soulful beauty of “O Ri O Sanwariya” from Bhooth Bangla
A melodious blend of folk and classical romance, this song captures the feeling of unspoken love, dreamy emotions, and timeless chemistry. With the magical voices of Shreya Ghoshal & Javed Ali and music by Pritam, every note feels poetic and heartfelt.
Featuring Akshay Kumar & Tabu, the visuals add grace and elegance to this beautifully crafted melody.
Let the music take you into a world of love and longing…
Song - O Ri O Sanwariya
Movie - Bhooth Bangla
Singers – Javed Ali, Shreya Ghoshal & Prithvi Gandharv
